Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for rules concerning off-campus behavior of higher education students.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to offcampus disruptive behavior of highereducation students; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each institution of higher education shall adopt rulesregarding disruptive offcampus conduct of students, includingsanctions. (2) Sanctions may include, but are not limited to, counseling,probation, suspension, or expulsion. (3) As used in this section, "disruptive offcampus conduct" meansany conduct that results in a citation or conviction for the violationof laws or ordinances and that: (a) Interferes with the institution of higher education'srelationship with the surrounding community; (b) Harms the reputation of the institution of higher education; or (c) Violates the institution of higher education's policies. (4) Each institution of higher education shall report the substance p. 1 SB 6706of the rules adopted under this section to the higher educationcommittees of the legislature by December 1, 2004.
